guides.favoredWhen: Even. She dodges with E and waits in shroud. Shield the E, punish the drop.

keyTips.text: Even skill lane: the E-dodge war decides it.
Silence her E1 mark: no mark means no follow-up.
Keep your spell shield for her engage: the passive eats the opener.

tips.text: She E-dodges: hold Q until her dash is spent.
Dodge her Q2: the second blast is the damage.
Never R a shrouded Akali: hold ult for the visible.
After 6 R the drop: shroud-down is ult-now.
Shield tracked plus ult held: the Akali who never touches you never wins.

sources.author: Anguish333
sources.rankClaim: Master (profile badge; title claims 2000LP GrandMaster EUW and Challenger EUNE) · Akali main

guides.favoredWhen: She bullies early and holds Charm for your shield and R. Survive, hide, and scale with jungle.

keyTips.text: She has strong early kill pressure and matches your push: concede the early.
Track her Charm and stand behind minions: the wave blocks it.
Keep your spell shield for her Charm timing: no shield means no walk-up.

tips.text: You are among the weakest early: almost no trading tools, so farm, do not fight.
Protect your voidlings: she kills them on spawn to manage the wave.
After 6 she plays with her jungler: ward and never step without cover.
Cast R only when her Charm is down: she times Charm on your cast.
Early respected plus shield tracked: the Ahri who never catches you never wins.

guides.favoredWhen: She bullies all game and kills your voidlings. Ward after 6 and survive the poke.

keyTips.text: She bullies you all game: accept the pressure lane.
Her Q kills your voidlings so you cannot push: protect the wave.
Your R needs setup: gank with jungle, never alone.

tips.text: Farm under tower: her Q breaks your push.
Trade nothing early: her range wins every exchange.
Track her Q cooldown: voidlings live when Q is down.
After 6, R with jungle cover: solo Rs die to her team.
Pushed in but alive: the Syndra who never dove you never wins.

guides.favoredWhen: He outranges and wins the lane. Survive on shield discipline, and play with your team.

keyTips.text: He outranges you and wins the lane: play for survival and jungle.
His team plays around his R: track the jungler before 6.
Keep your shield up through his Q: poke Qs strip it before the combo.

early-lane.text: Zed often places Living Shadow before Death Mark so he can swap away from skillshots. Hold your crowd control until he has used the swap.

win-condition.text: Death Mark always lands Zed behind his target. Pre-aim crowd control and escapes behind you, not toward where he cast it.

tips.text: He combos when you E the wave: spend E carefully.
Farm from max range: his Q out-trades yours.
Ward and play with your team: his R decides fights, not lane.
Punish spent shadows: W-down is your only window.
Death Mark lands him behind you: face the exit when he ults.
Survived plus warded: the Zed who never snowballed never kills you.

keyTips.text: Play the first levels cautiously, fighting only on clear edges while guarding health behind the passive shield.
At level 6, bring the jungler to convert Nether Grasp into a kill, and roam with R ready.
Refuse late commits without R available, since its suppression carries his teamfight control.

tips.text: Take longer trades once a few levels bank instead of only short poke.
Respect every all-in threat while the passive shield sits down early on its long cooldown.
Without a likely lane kill, clear the wave and carry the ultimate to a play elsewhere.
Farm a side lane for gold and experience whenever no fight brews.
Swap to the open side once bot rotates mid to keep earning without contest.
Track the minimap, objectives, and enemy jungler under mid pressure, forcing the opposing mid to answer instead of roaming free.
With R up, hunt isolated or overextended targets; each pick opens Baron or a nearby tower.
Against late or unsafe enemy-mid arrivals, shove for plates and ping the missing opponent to both sides.
Drop R on a lone overstepper, adding Flash plus R to catch exposed targets the team follows.
Into enemy engages, suppress the closest threat off the backline, or lock the highest-priority target instead.
Peel carries so their damage never stops; losing them early ends winning chances.
Value picks and wave-clear over solo-kill chasing, turning each pick into an objective or tower.

itemization.text: Run Flash and Teleport with Deathfire Touch, Manaflow Band, Transcendence, and Scorch plus Magical Footwear and Cosmic Insight.
Order Blackfire Torch first and Sorcerer's Shoes second, then Liandry's, Rylai's, Zhonya's, and Rabadon's in the popular build.
Slot Shadowflame fourth against healing- and shield-reliant teams.
Level E, W, Q first while prioritizing E, Q, and W after; ride the first-component spell frequency plus later cores and R ranks into stronger picks and teamfights.
Bend the defensive rune shard between armor and magic resistance by lane opponent.
